title: Retractable hooks and garment rod 10-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Traditional Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient, space-saving hanging storage with this retractable hooks and garment rod. The pullout rod extends to hold garments or towels, then retracts when not in use—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware layouts, classic bath accessories planning, or heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Retractable pullout garment rod for hanging towels or clothing
- Wall mount installs in an end wall or door frame
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Crafted from solid brass
- Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement options

Specs:
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Projection: 10 inches
- Overall dimensions: 10 in (L) x 2 in (W) x 1.9 in (H)
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Wall depth required to retract: 10 inches
- Included items: Brass rod, rod housing, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
